stopped.title: The desktop is stopped
stopped.body: Start it to watch the agents' screen here.

missing.title: No desktop on this device
missing.body: Install the agent desktop on this session's device, then try again.

no_url.title: The desktop has no link yet
no_url.body: Its stream isn't shared on the tailnet. Share it, then try again.

denied.title: The desktop didn't let Zeron in
denied.body: Its sign-in link was turned down. Try again for a fresh one.

not_approved.title: Desktop is waiting for you to allow it
not_approved.body: Allow it in Settings → Plugins on this session's device, then try again.

offline.title: Can't reach the desktop
offline.body: Zeron can't reach this session's device right now.

not_installed.title: Desktop isn't on this session's device
not_installed.body: Install it in Settings → Plugins on that device, then try again.

off.title: Desktop is off on this session's device
off.body: Turn it on in Settings → Plugins on that device, then try again.

version_mismatch.title: Desktop needs an update
version_mismatch.body: This session's device has a different version. Update it in Settings → Plugins.

timeout.title: The desktop didn't answer
timeout.body: Its device took too long. Try again in a moment.

failed.title: Couldn't reach the desktop
failed.body: Something went wrong on this session's device. Try again in a moment.
